descriptionChirho: The personal name Delaiah/Delayahu (meaning 'Yahweh has drawn up/delivered'), referring to several individuals in the Hebrew Bible including a priestly course leader (1 Chr 24:18), a prince in Jehoiakim's court (Jer 36:12,25), and a postexilic family head (Ezra 2:60, Neh 6:10, 7:62). All three sense clusters are merely prepositional/conjunctive variants of the same proper name: spa 'Delaías/y Delayahu,' arb 'دَلايا/وَدَلَايَا' (Dalaya), kor '들라야' (Deullaya), swa 'Delaya/na Delaya,' hin 'दलायाह/और दलायाह.'
